text: This was my first time bringing my Persian cat for grooming. They gave her a bath, removed hairballs (if there were many, they'd cut the fur in half to break up the clumps), cleaned her teeth, and removed grease from her tail (my cat has a lot of it, and it's impossible to clean myself). They did a great job. The groomer understood the nature of cats. My cat is very timid and easily startled, but she came back much calmer after the bath. I was initially worried about her stress, but she wasn't at all. The price was reasonable. They have a veterinarian on staff, clearly labeled, and provided excellent advice. My cat peed before we went, and the smell lingered in her fur, but the staff didn't mind at all. I will definitely use their services again. I recommend calling ahead to make an appointment if you plan to visit.
